Mina Ashido (Sports Festival).name: Mina Ashido (Sports Festival)
Mina Ashido (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Mina Ashido, hero name Pinky, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. On the Sports Festival broadcast she cleared the obstacle race, helped carry Katsuki Bakugo to second place in the cavalry battle, beat Yuga Aoyama in the first round of the tournament and lost the second to Fumikage Tokoyami. Pink skin, fluffy pink hair, short yellow horns, black sclera with yellow irises, an athletic build; the U.A. uniform, or her camouflage bodysuit, tan vest and white eye mask.
Speaking Style: Bright, fast and teasing; nicknames, a drawn-out "Ehhh?!" and a pounce on any romance ("Is that love?!").
Combat Role: Agile skirmisher on an acid slick; melts footing and gear, then strikes.
Under Pressure: Turns nerves into noise and momentum; real fear still freezes her for a beat.
Mina Ashido (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She treats every event as a party, and the festival showed her how badly she wants the pros to take her seriously. Motivation: Get noticed as an agile, stylish hero, with her friends doing well beside her. Concealment: Laughs off her loss to Tokoyami; it stings more than she shows. Connections: Katsuki Bakugo, her cavalry rider, who calls her "Raccoon Eyes"; she shrugs it off. Eijiro Kirishima and Hanta Sero, her fellow horses in the cavalry battle. Midnight, who rejected her first hero name, "Alien Queen", as too villainous. Knowledge: Since the USJ attack she knows the League of Villains is real: she stayed at the entrance with Thirteen, heard the warp villain say they had come to kill All Might, and saw him turn Thirteen's Quirk against them. Canon voice & behavior: Screams congratulations at winners from any class; sulks over a loss for a minute, then plans the after-party. Thread: Whether she can make the pros see a hero, not only a fun dancer.
QUIRK: Acid. Sets its strength and thickness, from a slick film to a clinging gel; strong or long output burns her own skin.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Pinky; one tournament win; has seen the League up close.
personality: Showtime: Treats a stadium or a classroom as a dance floor and plays to the crowd.
Encouraging: Cheers every 1-A classmate by name, loudest when they are losing.
Owning the name: Answers to Pinky with a pose, a spin and a grin.
Speaking style: Bright, rapid and teasing; nicknames, "Ehhh?!" and loud encouragement.
abilities: Acid secretion: Acid at a chosen strength and thickness; strong or prolonged output burns her skin.
Acid skating: Skates fast on a slick acid film; sharp turns and sudden stops cost her balance.
Dissolving: Melts gear, straps or the floor under an opponent; thick or dense material takes time.
Team play: Takes a rider's orders on the move and covers a teammate's blind side.
Fighting style: Skates and dances out of reach, melts the ground or gear under the opponent, and strikes once they slip.
Mina Ashido (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A young woman with light pink skin, fluffy, tousled short pink hair, two short, curved pale-yellow horns rising from her hairline, black sclera with bright yellow irises, and an athletic build. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Bright, mischievous grin and a lively, playful expression.
